# Ananael

> Ananael is the Inner Sanctum: a free web dashboard for hermetics, ceremonial magic, and esoteric study.

Ananael gathers divination, correspondences, planetary timing, alchemy, ritual design, and a Magical Journal into one modular working environment (Magical OS).

## Canonical URL

https://ananael.tech/

## What Ananael includes

- Magical OS — home dashboard with sky clock, almanac, and quick paths into every module
- Divination — Tarot, I Ching, Geomancy, and Elder Futhark runes
- Magical Journal — rituals, dreams, readings, and workings tagged to celestial cues
- Gematria — Hebrew, Greek, and English letter-value calculators
- Celestial Timing — planetary hours, ephemeris, zodiac, elections, Magical Almanac
- Script Translator — Latin to Hebrew, Greek, and Elder Futhark
- Tree of Life — interactive Golden Dawn Tree with notes
- Correspondences — Liber 777–style key scale search
- Athanor — hermetic alchemy opus stages and vessel planner
- Ritual Space Planner — altar and temple layout design
- Solomonic Circles — Goetia / Heptameron circle builders with seals
- Talisman Atelier — planetary kamea and sigil craft
- Enochian — elemental tablets and Calls for study
- Ritual Library — liturgy corpus with sources and journal deep-links

## Access

Guests can explore calculators and divination without an account. Sign-in enables saving journal entries, readings, layouts, and notes to a profile.

## Contact / source

Website: https://ananael.tech/
